title: 200 foreigners rounded up in Zamboanga Sibugay anti-scam op

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Government security forces intercepted nearly 200 foreign nationals suspected of involvement in transnational cyber scams and immigration violations during joint law enforcement operations in the towns of Alicia and Siay in Zamboanga Sibugay on Friday. ​The alien suspects are undergoing verification by the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and the Bureau of Immigration (BI) to determine their legal status, individual liability, and potential links to organized criminal syndicates. ​Authorities are also investigating indications that several of the foreign workers may be victims of human trafficking, forced labor, and unlawful recruitment who were subjected to coercion […]...
